events.summary: New Agent Controls let customers see every AI agent connected to their Mercury account, set what each agent can do with Mercury enforcing those rules on every agent request, and view a record of agent activity.
events.headline: Mercury launches Agent Controls for AI agents

events.summary: Eligible customers who have not previously subscribed to a paid plan can now try Mercury Plus free for 30 days, unlocking recurring invoices, ACH debit ($1/transaction), unlimited 1099 tax filings, and priority support; after the trial it renews at $35/month.
events.headline: 30-day free trial of Mercury Plus introduced

events.summary: The redesigned Mercury Treasury recommends a portfolio built around a business's monthly expenses with U.S. Treasury ladders for longer-term cash, auto-rebalancing as ladder rungs mature; available to customers with $250K+ across Mercury accounts.
events.headline: Mercury Treasury redesigned with U.S. Treasury ladders

events.summary: Mercury Payroll brings W-2 and 1099 contractor payroll, health benefits and 401(k), and white-glove payroll tax compliance into the Mercury account across all 50 states, with AI-assisted tasks via Mercury Command; free through end of 2026, then $100/month plus $50/month per person paid starting January 1, 2027.
events.headline: Mercury launches AI-native Mercury Payroll

events.summary: Customers can now ask ChatGPT or Claude to move money, pay a recipient, or categorize transactions on their Mercury account via MCP, with every answer grounded in account data and nothing moving until the user approves it.
events.headline: Take action on your Mercury account from ChatGPT and Claude

events.summary: Customers on Mercury's Plus and Pro subscription plans now get faster, priority support, while all Mercury customers retain access to 24/7 support.
events.headline: Priority Support added for Plus and Pro plan customers

events.summary: Multiple Mercury accounts can now be connected to move money between them directly, with same-bank transfers landing in seconds, auto-transfer rules on a set schedule, and recurring transfers to accounts outside Mercury.
events.headline: Linked Mercury accounts with money movement and auto-transfers

events.summary: Customers can send real-time payments through the Mercury API by setting realTimePayment as the paymentMethod, with funds arriving in seconds 24/7/365 on Mercury Business and Personal accounts provided through Column, N.A.
events.headline: Real-time payments now available through the Mercury API

events.summary: Businesses can now set up wire drawdowns from Mercury accounts provided through both Column, N.A. and Choice Financial Group, authorizing payroll providers like Sequoia and Gusto to withdraw funds directly.
events.headline: Wire drawdowns for payroll providers authorized on Mercury accounts
